references.text: The sacrifice of the Spirit is a broken heart; a broken and crushed heart you will not despise, O God.
But they were rebellious and grieved his Holy Spirit; therefore he turned to become their enemy, he himself fought against them.
And I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that have nothing more they can do.
You stiff-necked people, uncircumcised in heart and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit. As your fathers did, so do you too.
